data.title: Laird Superfood Appoints Mark Johnson as Chief Financial Officer
data.description: In Boulder, Colorado, Laird Superfood, Inc. (NYSE American: LSF) has appointed Mark Johnson as the Chief Financial Officer, starting from October 1, 2026. Reporting directly to CEO Jason Vieth, Johnson will take on the roles of the principal financial officer and principal accounting officer for the company. With over 25 years of experience in finance leadership within public consumer packaged goods and private equity-backed firms, Johnson's arrival from a previous position brings significant expertise to Laird Superfood.

data.title: G7 urges adoption of post-quantum security, as powerful computers pose threat to encryption. Take action now.
data.description: Organizations are being encouraged to implement post-quantum security measures to safeguard against the potential threat posed by advanced computers. These security measures are essential as current encryption methods and digital signatures may be vulnerable to attacks with the increasing power of quantum computers. It is crucial for organizations to take proactive steps to enhance their security protocols before these new computers can compromise the existing systems.

data.title: Major Drilling Announces Results of Annual Meeting of Shareholders
data.description: Major Drilling Group International Inc., the leading provider of drilling services to the mining industry, successfully elected all director nominees listed in the Management Information Circular of July 16, 2026, during their hybrid annual general meeting of shareholders held on September 3, 2026, in MONCTON, New Brunswick. This event saw significant shareholder engagement, with over 79% of shares voted, equivalent to 65,553,399 common shares of the Corporation. The company is traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol MDI.

data.title: Crane NXT to Participate in the 2026 Jefferies Global Industrial Conference
data.description: Crane NXT, Co. (NYSE: CXT), based in Waltham, Mass., revealed its involvement in the upcoming 2026 Jefferies Global Industrial Conference scheduled for September 10, 2026. The event will feature a fireside chat at 1:30 p.m. Eastern Time with key executives including Aaron Saak, President and CEO, and Christina Cristiano, Senior VP and CFO. Crane NXT specializes in authentication and traceability technologies, establishing itself as a prominent player in the global market.

data.title: AVANTE CORP. ANNOUNCES OPTION GRANT
data.description: Avante Corp., a leading provider of technology-enabled security solutions, based in Toronto, Ontario, disclosed today the approval of 100,000 stock options for a senior employee of one of its subsidiaries. These options allow for the purchase of up to 100,000 common shares of the company, in accordance with the 10% rolling stock option plan. The grant date for this announcement is September 4, 2026. The issuance of these options is subject to the conditions outlined in the plan. Avante Corp. is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol XX and on the OTC market under the symbol ALXXF.

data.title: GreenCore Solutions Corp. (GSC) AI Agent Stack Passes 24.5 Million Inbound AI Agent Transactions In 30 Days
data.description: Brendan Farrugia, one of the co-founders and Director of GSC Agentic Pty. Ltd., a joint venture company, has officially become a member of the GSC Board of Advisors. The announcement came from GreenCore Solutions Corp. (GSC) on September 4, 2026, with headquarters in Vancouver, BC, and Sydney. The Company revealed a noteworthy achievement with its AI Agent Stack, marking a record-breaking month.

data.title: ASU a partner in new national Foundry School announced by White House
data.description: A national initiative to train the next wave of workers in American manufacturing has chosen Arizona State University as one of its flagship institutions. This initiative, led by the U.S. Department of State, aims to strengthen the workforce in this critical sector. ASU is one of eight universities selected for this program, highlighting its dedication to preparing skilled professionals for the industry. The initiative, known as The Foundry School, launched on September 4, 2026. This selection underscores ASU's commitment to innovative education and its role in shaping the future workforce.

data.title: Football Is Back: Raiders Bring the Drama and Passion of Raider Nation to Life in Mexico
data.description: With the resumption of football activities, the Raiders have announced the release of the concluding episodes of Corazón de Plata y Negro, a telenovela-themed series that portrays the emotions and fervor of being a fan in an engaging manner. Julio Bracho and Jimena Sánchez recently participated in NFL Mexico's NFL Kickoff Event, where they joined the Raider Nation community to introduce the final chapters of the series. This event witnessed a significant turnout, with an impressive number of fans showing up to celebrate the beloved sport.

data.title: M.C. Layman Marks Two Years as Founder Kate Layman Joins Two Frederick County Boards
data.description: In Frederick, Maryland, on September 4, 2026, Kate Layman, the founder of M.C. Layman, celebrates the company's two-year anniversary. She has taken on two new leadership positions within the Frederick community. Layman has been named to the Board of Directors of Woodsboro Bank, making significant strides since the company's establishment.
